purpose: Written BEFORE the gap-down strategy placed a single trade, so the bar cannot be moved after seeing results. evaluate.py fingerprints this file (criteria_gap.lock) the first time it runs and warns if it changes.
what_it_is: research/lab.py F5_gap(2.0, -1, 0, 0.2, 1, 0, 1): buy stocks that open 2%+ below yesterday's close at the first minute's close, stop 0.2 x ATR(14), target 1R, long only; Claude may veto on news. Study 3 discovery (2016-2021, 26 stocks): +0.168R over 1,219 trades after costs, but the luck test was not passed (p = 0.149), so this is an experiment, not a proven edge.

how_to_read_the_verdict.KEEP RUNNING: Not enough trades yet. This is NOT a failure. Change nothing and keep collecting results.
how_to_read_the_verdict.FAILED: Enough data and at least one bar missed. Do not go near real money with this strategy. Any rule change is a new experiment with a new frozen criteria file.
how_to_read_the_verdict.MET: Every bar cleared on enough data: paper trades, the unfiltered forward test, and Claude's veto not hurting. That earns a discussion about a very small real-money trial with tight limits. It proves nothing about the future.
